summary: Phase 149O.18C -- AG3 Mandatory Consumption Integration: bounded production implementation phase (Wave C of the 149O.17 plan). Confirmed baseline: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.18B completed/complete, HMRC-001 v1.0 VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- CONFORMS, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read HMRC-001, the 149O.18A and 149O.18B phase documents, hatp_mandatory_cutover.py and hatp_rollback_consumption.py's exact production signatures, and execute_rollback in full (agent.py:5234-5391), independently re-inventoried every production caller of execute_rollback (exactly one: commands/agent.py:2238; a same-named function in cltr_migration.py's rehearsal module is unrelated). Wired 149O.18A's fresh resolve_production_hatp_cutover_mode and 149O.18B's real-effect evaluate_for_real_effect into execute_rollback's Mandatory Consumption Boundary, placed immediately before _run_git_revert (HMRC-REQ-066): the pre-existing unconditional rollback_approval_state gate is now skipped entirely once the deployment is HATP_MANDATORY (it supplies zero authority post-cutover, HMRC-REQ-061 -- no residual legacy-AND-HATP requirement, proven by a test showing an unapproved job still reaches effect given a deterministic HMRC ALLOW); LEGACY_COMPATIBLE/PREPARED dispatch is byte-identical to before. In HATP_MANDATORY, the boundary requires an explicit hatp_evidence_id, constructs an Ag3RollbackApprovalContext, calls evaluate_for_real_effect (never evaluate_for_advisory, statically and behaviorally confirmed), and requires pb_decision == DECISION_ALLOW before _run_git_revert may run; missing evidence, PB DENY/HUMAN_REVIEW, raw hatp_proof/hatp_evidence parameters, and a direct-function-call bypass (skipping commands/agent.py entirely) all fail closed with zero effect. Mode is read fresh twice (never cached): an early, non-authoritative read gating only the legacy check, and a boundary read immediately before the effect that is the sole authority source, so a mode transition mid-call is still enforced at the actual attempt. While building this phase's own test suite, wiring resolve_production_hatp_cutover_mode into execute_rollback exactly as specified caused 8 pre-existing tests/test_agent.py -k rollback regressions: the current real deployment (and any deployment lacking .pcae/repository-identity.json) has no local repository identity, and 149O.18A's _resolve_cutover_mode_at_root unconditionally failed closed to HATP_MANDATORY on identity-absence -- before ever consulting the protected root's Cutover Record or marker -- directly contradicting HMRC-REQ-032's explicit LEGACY_COMPATIBLE default for every existing deployment including the current local development host. Classified this as a narrow, proven API defect (HMRC-REQ-045's Cutover Record schema itself requires a repository_instance_id to exist at write time, so identity-absence plus a protected root with zero activation evidence anywhere is unambiguous first-install proof) and applied a single-hunk correction reusing the existing, unmodified _read_cutover_record/_read_cutover_activation_marker readers -- only the doubly-absent (no record, no marker) case now resolves LEGACY_COMPATIBLE; any activation evidence at all (valid, corrupt, or symlinked, for any repository) still fails closed exactly as before, re-verified by dedicated tests proving the security property (an agent deleting its own local identity file cannot escape a genuinely activated deployment) is unchanged. Also discovered and fixed two pre-existing, never-previously-exercised bugs in the Wave-7 (149O.6) advisory hatp_authority block inside execute_rollback itself (read_git_branch(str(root.path)) -- a type mismatch raising AttributeError -- corrected to read_git_branch(root)) while building tests that, for the first time, supply hatp_evidence_id through that code path. Authored 44 new tests across two files (20 in tests/test_ag3_hatp_mandatory_consumption.py: LEGACY_COMPATIBLE/PREPARED regression, no-dual-authority, missing/invalid-evidence fail-closed, PB DENY/HUMAN_REVIEW blocking, the real current POL-005 consequence confirmed end-to-end, deterministic-ALLOW exactly-one-effect, direct-call bypass prevention, raw-hook rejection, no-cache repeat-attempt re-evaluation, signature closure, effect-truthfulness, and a real temporary-git-repository effect test proving both a genuine LEGACY_COMPATIBLE revert and a blocked HATP_MANDATORY non-effect against real git, not the project repository; 24 in tests/test_phase_149o_18c_ag3_mandatory_consumption_integration.py: production file allowlist for both changed files, 18B byte-identity, full re-verification of the classified 18A correction, all seven contract byte-identities, AG5/CLI/PB non-change, effect-ordering, single-production-caller confirmation via a live grep, and a live re-confirmation that this actual repository now resolves LEGACY_COMPATIBLE end-to-end), plus one stale 18A-suite assertion replaced and two new security-property tests added to tests/test_hatp_mandatory_cutover.py, all added to Fast Green. Ran a full regression sweep (tests/test_agent.py -k rollback: 78/78 passed after the correction, 8 failed before it, both independently confirmed; the full -k "149o or hatp" sweep A/B-diffed via git stash against the clean 149O.18B baseline: 124 pre-existing failures, exactly 13 newly-invalidated by this phase's own src/pcae/ diff, all the identical mechanical zero-diff-since-my-own-baseline snapshot pattern every historical HATP-lineage phase test already carries, plus one governance-gate false-positive attributable to the session's active task still being the post-149O.18B idle placeholder, resolved by the normal task-lifecycle transition -- no AG3/AG5/rollback/Permission-Broker behavioral regression found in either sweep). VERDICT: AG3 MANDATORY HATP CONSUMPTION INTEGRATION: IMPLEMENTED -- READY FOR 149O.18D. No AG5 mandatory-consumption integration, no --hatp-evidence-id CLI plumbing, no legacy approve-command change, and no Permission Broker/POL-005 change was made. HMRC-001 v1.0 and all six other upstream contracts remain byte-unchanged; hatp_rollback_consumption.py (149O.18B) remains byte-unchanged. No real Cutover Record or HATP_MANDATORY activation occurred. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Recommended next phase: 149O.18D -- AG5 Mandatory Consumption Integration.
